changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The mentor's attempts: one per request version, leased on the database clock under an epoch and a token. Each row belongs to one account. Nothing writes the table before the release that registers it in the person-data inventory.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE public.mentor_attempt ( id UUID NOT NULL CONSTRAINT mentor_attemptPK PRIMARY KEY, account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, request_id UUID NOT NULL, request_version INTEGER NOT NULL, work_class VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, end_reason VARCHAR(32), claims INTEGER NOT NULL, lease_epoch BIGINT NOT NULL, lease_token UUID, leased_until TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE, due_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, deadline TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, basis_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, ended_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE, CONSTRAINT uk_mentor_attempt_version UNIQUE (account_id, request_id, request_version), CONSTRAINT uk_mentor_attempt_owner UNIQUE (account_id, id), -- A foreign key ignores row-level security, so the reference names the owner too. Every eraser of a request, -- an older release's included, removes its attempts with it. CONSTRAINT sfk_mentor_attempt_request FOREIGN KEY (account_id, request_id) REFERENCES public.mentor_request (account_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX idx_mentor_attempt_due ON public.mentor_attempt (account_id, work_class, state, due_at);
ALTER TABLE public.mentor_attempt ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY mentor_attempt_owner ON public.mentor_attempt TO hephaestus_app USING (account_id = public.current_owner_account()) WITH CHECK (account_id = public.current_owner_account());
